topic: Adjusting campaign frequency formula for reach
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on correcting the calculation of campaign frequency. Initially, [p1] noted that the existing formula for frequency was complex and did not account for updates to reach. They requested a fix.

[me] suggested simplifying the formula to `viewed_impressions_per_face / reach`. This was confirmed by [p1].

Following this, [me] implemented the change as a hotfix, which [p1] requested be deployed to staging first for review before moving to production. Later, [p1] assigned a task via ClickUp to further adjust the new reach formula, specifying that while the work should be done, deployment must wait for explicit confirmation from [p1].
decisions: The campaign frequency calculation was updated to use `viewed_impressions_per_face / reach`.
action_items: [me] needs to complete the task assigned in ClickUp regarding the new reach formula adjustment.
[me] must wait for confirmation from [p1] before deploying any changes to production.
